# Test comprehensive output validation
# Verifies that generated code has correct structure and can be compiled

env INPUT_DIR=$HOME/.appledocs/cache/developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation

mkdir validated_output
exec generate-framework-bindings -framework CoreGraphics -input $INPUT_DIR -output validated_output

# Verify file structure
exists validated_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
exists validated_output/coregraphics/types.gen.go

# Check functions.gen.go structure
grep 'package coregraphics' validated_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
grep '// Code generated from Apple documentation' validated_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go

# Check types.gen.go structure
grep 'package coregraphics' validated_output/coregraphics/types.gen.go

# Verify type definitions
grep 'type CGRect struct' validated_output/coregraphics/types.gen.go

# Verify function references exist
grep 'CGRect' validated_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
